camera_evidence.lens_and_pitch: MEASURED (MEDIUM): vanishing-point scans in three segments of S7: f 1265/1183/1271 px @640, pitch 57.7/59.4/56.2 deg; nadir support 1100-1770 (harbour 9500, plaza ~1000).
camera_evidence.track: MEASURED (window f450-f484 only): translating camera with free height (ECC median 0.84); the whole shot could not be registered cleanly (islands at several heights, cliffs and void below the ground carry parallax, a rotating hazard), so this map is built in FRAME MODE from one reference frame.
camera_evidence.framing: OBSERVED: the game camera is reference frame f470's own camera (canvas = that frame at x3); nothing outside it is shown.
camera_evidence.world_scale: MEASURED: the pack characters are one size on every map, so the world scale follows the footage's characters. The carrot in S7 is ~28 x 17 px (f440, f540) against 35 x 21 px for the plaza-fitted bake through this camera -> character_scale 0.80 (+-0.05); world units per plan unit = 2000 / 0.80 = 2500, so the rules' player radius (36) matches the drawn characters.
